articles.title: Airbnb Recreates K3G's Raichand House in Mumbai, Bookings Open November 23
articles.excerpt: For the film's 25th anniversary, Airbnb's free two-hour 'At Home with the Raichands' experience runs December 1–6 in Mumbai with 180 invitations — the grand staircase, the family study and Poo's closet, rebuilt for fans.
articles.image_caption: The recreated Raichand House in Mumbai, with its grand double staircase, built by Airbnb for the 25th anniversary of Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham. The free two-hour experience runs December 1-6, 2026, with booking requests opening November 23.
articles.nri_angle: A free, bookable piece of Bollywood nostalgia in Mumbai this December — requests open November 23, timed for diaspora fans planning a winter trip home.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

dates.event: Booking requests open at 12 p.m. IST

articles.title: Air India Restores Non-Stop Flights to New York, Cutting Travel Time by Five Hours
articles.excerpt: All four routes — Delhi and Mumbai to JFK and Newark — are non-stop again after the Rome refuelling stop was dropped, with journeys down from around 22 hours to approximately 17.
articles.image_caption: An Air India Airbus A350-900 in the airline's new livery on the tarmac. Air India has restored non-stop services from Delhi and Mumbai to New York, cutting journey times by up to five hours.
articles.nri_angle: For US-based diaspora travellers, the India-New York journey drops by up to five hours with the Rome stop gone, on daily JFK services and near-daily Newark services.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Air India Says US Flights Ran On Schedule Despite Ground Stop
articles.excerpt: In a Saturday-evening update reversing its earlier delay warning, Air India said its New York, Newark and San Francisco flights landed and departed on time — with one documented exception, a San Francisco departure more than three hours late.

sources.label: Business Standard (syndicated report via The S Bharat)

articles.nri_angle: Air India's nonstop U.S.–India services are the diaspora's main direct link home; the airline's confirmation that New York, Newark and San Francisco flights ran on time means most India-bound travellers face connection risk, not a cancelled long-haul flight.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Tourism Boom Is Real — and Lopsided: 4.29 Billion Domestic Visits, but Growth Concentrated in a Few Markets
articles.excerpt: Domestic tourist visits jumped 45.6% to about 4.29 billion in 2025, yet hotel occupancy runs at 75% in tier-one cities against 57% in tier-three markets, and a 161,000-room pipeline is betting on closing that gap.
articles.image_caption: The Taj Mahal in Agra, one of India's most visited tourist sites.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora travellers, the numbers explain the split experience of India trips: polished capacity in the big metros, thinner hotel supply in the smaller cities family visits actually go to.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Weekly Train to Link Nepal's Janakpur Dham With Ayodhya Over 604 Kilometres
articles.excerpt: The government has announced a weekly service between Janakpur Dham and Ayodhya Cantt, departing Janakpur on Saturdays and Ayodhya on Mondays, with stops across Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.
articles.image_caption: Janaki Mandir in Janakpur, Nepal, photographed in August 2017. Archival photograph.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora pilgrims planning a Ramayana Circuit trip, the train links Sita's birthplace and Ram's birthplace in one weekly cross-border journey.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.excerpt: Spy photographs near Toyota's Zárate plant show a comprehensive facelift for the SUV sold locally as the SW4, with an India launch expected in 2027 but not yet confirmed by Toyota.
articles.nri_angle: Indian and diaspora SUV buyers tracking the Fortuner's next update get an early look at its design direction, with an India launch expected in 2027 but not yet confirmed by Toyota.

articles.title: Air India Warns of US Flight Delays After FAA Ground Stop Snarls Departures Nationwide
articles.excerpt: A telecommunications outage forced the FAA to halt US departures on Friday. The ground stop has since been lifted, but Air India says consequential disruption to its US flights is possible and passengers should check their flight status before leaving for the airport.
articles.image_caption: An Air India aircraft on a fog-covered runway, alongside passengers waiting at a check-in area in a US airport. Air India advised passengers travelling to and from the US to check their flight status after the FAA ground stop disrupted departures nationwide.
articles.nri_angle: Air India's nonstops link US gateways such as New York, Newark, San Francisco, Chicago and Washington with Delhi and Mumbai; diaspora travellers booked this weekend should re-check their flight status before heading to the airport.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

steps.detail: Open the airline's official website or app before leaving for the airport.
Select 'Flight Status' from the drop-down menu.
You can use the flight number, PNR or route along with the date of travel.
Plan your journey to the airport around the current status, not the original schedule.

articles.title: Air India Extends Saudi Suspensions: Riyadh, Dammam to November 30
articles.excerpt: Air India and Air India Express will keep Riyadh and Dammam flights suspended until November 30, 2026 and Jeddah until November 21, with free rescheduling or a full refund for eligible bookings issued on or before November 10.
articles.nri_angle: The extended suspension affects Indian workers, families and Umrah travellers who rely on direct Air India group flights between India and Riyadh, Dammam and Jeddah.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jaipur Monuments Draw Bigger Crowds as Post-Diwali Tourist Surge Builds
articles.excerpt: Amer Fort jumped from 8,186 to 10,923 visitors in a day as Diwali trips extended and winter arrivals began. With the Pushkar Fair opening November 19, Rajasthan's peak season is already under way.
articles.image_caption: Amer Fort in Jaipur, Rajasthan. The fort received 10,923 visitors on November 10, according to Tourism Department figures reported by ANI, as Jaipur's post-Diwali tourist surge built toward the winter season.
articles.nri_angle: Jaipur is a first stop on most diaspora winter trips to India; monument footfall already at peak levels tells visiting families to book early and start Amer Fort at opening time.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Chicago's Field Museum Hosts Diwali Celebration With Dance, Diyas and Ayurveda on November 15
articles.excerpt: The museum's Cultural Programming series marks the festival of lights on Sunday, November 15, from 12:30 to 5 p.m., with classical dance, Bollywood performances, henna, diya decorating, and two science sessions — all included with admission.
articles.nri_angle: A family-friendly Diwali programme at one of Chicago's major museums gives the region's Indian community a public celebration the Sunday after the festival.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Airlines Cut Diwali Flights For First Time Since Covid As Fares Surge
articles.excerpt: Cirium data reported by Bloomberg put October–November scheduled flights about 6% below a year earlier, while a separate weekly domestic count also fell — with fares on some routes doubling in effect.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora travellers heading to India for Diwali face fewer flights and higher fares on thinner routes, and should recheck schedules before travelling.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
